issues.on_page: Governmental funds balance sheet total 1,323,236 (pp4-5) equals government-wide governmental activities 1,323,236 (p1)
issues.issue: The governmental funds statement ties to the government-wide governmental column (no capital assets or debt there), so the cash-basis rule would take the governmental lines from the funds statement (fund balance by classification). The extractor kept the Statement of Net Position Total column because business-type activities carry capital assets and debt. Defensible for a mixed report, but an assumption.
